Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1406
Claimant:
Aaron Gonzalez
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
October 27, 2024
First notice of loss received from the claimant's attorney, who reports a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection
involving the insured's vehicle. The attorney states the claimant has neck and back pain and is represented going
forward.
November 20, 2024
Confirmed the driver listed on the policy was operating the insured vehicle at the time of loss, and the policy was in
force with no gaps in coverage. No indication the damage predates the policy start.
November 26, 2024
Police report obtained. It places the claimant's vehicle in the stopped lane at the time of impact and records the other
driver's account, which matches the claimant's statement.
December 14, 2024
Two independent witnesses gave statements describing the impact the same way the claimant and the other driver
did. Scene photos reviewed and consistent with the described collision.
December 18, 2024
Vehicle inspection completed. Rear bumper, trunk lid and tail lamp damage is consistent with the force of the reported
impact. A few older scratches near the bumper may predate this loss and have been noted separately for the
estimate.
December 30, 2024
Claimant's attorney provided the medical summary. Reported injuries are neck and back strain, which fit the type and
force of a rear-end impact of this kind.
January 3, 2025
Records show no prior treatment to the neck or back area in the records reviewed so far. Rqeuested prior claim
history to confirm.
January 5, 2025
Treatment followed a typical course of physical therapy and medication. Provider notes show steady improvement,
and vistis have tapered as the claimant recovers.
February 18, 2025
Claimant has given the same account of the collision in each contact, including the attorney's correspondence, the
recorded statement and the medical intake forms.
March 25, 2025
Reviewed the file. The accident, the claimant's presence in the vehicle, the damage and the injury pattern all line up,
so the claim is proceeding under standard handling with the attorney as point of contact.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
